issues.description: The getter for the stock ingredients has inconsistent return types across artifacts. The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" (implying a getter matching the private field type). In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) the method getStockIngredients() is declared to return java.util.List<StockIngredient> (line 17). In the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) the method getStockIngredients() returns StockIngredient[] (line 14). This discrepancy (List<StockIngredient> vs StockIngredient[]) is likely to confuse students about which signature to implement and may cause mismatches in code that expects the array or the list type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter return type consistent across the template, solution, and problem statement. Preferred fix: change the template's getStockIngredients() signature to 'public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients()' and return the internal array (this.stockIngredients) so it matches the private field and the solution. Alternatively, if List<StockIngredient> is preferred, update the solution and the problem statement to accept a List return type and update any call sites accordingly.
